## An educational action {#educational-action}

An action in this educational example means a step taken to revise a course.
That sense is distinct from the mathematical concept of a
[group action](#def-group-action). This link is explicit author markup.
This paragraph deliberately uses the ordinary word action without an automatic
link or a mathematics identity assertion.

The declared educational concept references the mathematical concept because
this synthetic course-revision example discusses including that definition in
a lesson. The relation expresses an editorial association, not a prerequisite
for every educational action.

## The same included definition

{{< include _definition.qmd >}}

The semantic group-action object has an occurrence on this page as well as on
the [mathematics page](index.qmd#def-group-action). Its identity stays the same,
while its two containing-document destinations differ.
